dos: Do keep all chrome in @repo/ui tokens and primitives; put mosaic-only geometry in --tile-size, --mosaicGap, --color-0..4, --rotation-x on the mosaic node.
Do keep tiles flat squares with hidden overflow and let gap (0–64px) draw the grid rhythm.
Do use the four action families exactly as assigned: aurora / Shuffle Colors, amber / Shuffle Rotations, neon-violet / Cycle Palettes, solder / Regenerate Tiles.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (500ms → 0–1ms, infinite spin → single turn) on every tile, thumb, and spinner transition.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and keyboard semantics (radio, pressed, roving Segmented) on every control.
donts: Don't add an app-local color, font, radius, or shadow — theme changes flow through @repo/ui, never an app stylesheet.
Don't bake mosaic colors into CSS or canonize the fallback grays (#333333–#bbbbbb); palettes are runtime data.
Don't give tiles static shadows, radii, or borders.
Don't depend on PG_LAB or sibling packages; Mosaic Maker must stay runnable solo under vp dev.
Don't put logic-driven styling outside CSS variables — pure modules talk to the DOM only through style.setProperty.
keyCharacteristics: Joyful toy: coarse, partial control beats precise control; every render drifts.
Neutral chrome, loud artwork: the frame recedes so the mosaic leads.
Flat-by-default lab instrument: depth appears only on hover, press, or focus.
narrative.overview: Mosaic Maker is a joyful toy, not a tool. The chrome is a calm laboratory bench; the artwork is the kinetic, ever-drifting mosaic it holds. Panels, buttons, and sliders stay small, neutral, and tactile so that scrubbing a control and watching hundreds of SVG tiles mutate feels immediate and surprising. The interface is entirely inherited from @repo/ui — there is no app-private visual world. Mosaic Maker adds only one signature surface on top: a live CSS-contract grid rendered as flat 100×100 SVG tiles.

rules.body: Chrome stays gruvbox neutral; hue lives in the mosaic tiles (--color-0..4) and the four action families.
rules.name: The Neutral Chrome Rule

rules.body: --color-0..4 are runtime content from nice-color-palettes (fallback cool grays #333333–#bbbbbb), never brand tokens.
rules.name: The Dynamic Palette Rule

rules.body: Sans names and acts; Mono measures and reports. Never set a numeric readout or eyebrow in Sans, never set a sentence in Mono.
rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule

rules.body: Section titles are always Mono 0.75rem, uppercase, wide-tracked, muted.
rules.name: The Uppercase Eyebrow Rule

rules.body: No static drop shadows on panels, stage, or tiles. If it is not hovered, pressed, focused, or floating, it is flat.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
